claims.disproof_condition: 條件：NVIDIA 或 Cisco 之後的一手（部落格、GTC、法說、規格）寫出 USFP 取消、延後到 400G/lane 之後的世代，或 400G/lane 的 scale-out 網路只用 CPO、不再有可插拔選項。核查頻率：每半年（GTC、OCP、OFC）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀可插拔收發器層與 CPO 層（CPO 層反證③的方向），騎 CPO／外部光源的敘事重答「替代品」那一格。
claims.statement: NVIDIA blog (OCP 2026-10-12): NVIDIA and Cisco announced plans for USFP, an optical pluggable transceiver form factor with about the OSFP footprint that will provide a path to 400Gb/s-per-lane networking and extend the transceiver-based deployment model, preserving the flexibility and serviceability of pluggable optics; NVIDIA and Cisco are working with TE Connectivity and Amphenol on cages, connectors and modules as a community-led, multi-source effort. A plan, not a shipping product; no volumes or dates are stated.

source_doc.permission_basis: NVIDIA 官方部落格公開文章；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。
source_doc.title: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide（NVIDIA 部落格，2026-10-12）：NVIDIA 與 Cisco 發布 USFP 可插拔光模組規格，走向每通道 400G、延續可插拔部署模式，與 TE、Amphenol 多來源推進

sources.quote: At OCP, NVIDIA and Cisco announced plans for USFP, a new optical pluggable transceiver module form factor designed to help AI factory builders scale next-generation AI fabrics while improving bandwidth density and power efficiency.

With approximately the same footprint as the widely adopted 200Gb/s-per-lane OSFP form factor, USFP will provide a path to 400Gb/s-per-lane networking and will extend a transceiver-based deployment model already proven across generations of data center networks.

The new form factor is designed for the scale and efficiency demands of next generation AI factories, supporting higher-bandwidth fabrics while preserving the flexibility and serviceability that have made pluggable optics a mainstay of modern data centers.

To help drive an open ecosystem, NVIDIA and Cisco are collaborating with TE Connectivity and Amphenol on cages, connectors and modules, with plans to advance USFP through a community-led, multi-source effort.
